initial_prompt: Write a sonnet about a brave little toaster.

messages.content: Write a sonnet about a brave little toaster.

Upon the counter sits a knight of chrome,
With coils of fire sleeping in his chest.
Though far away from any grander home,
He seeks to put his courage to the test.

No dragon breathes as hot as he can glow,
When levers drop and current starts to hum.
Through dark and dusty attics he will go,
To see the Master's happy morning come.

He fears no magnet, rust, or junkyard fate,
Nor appliance crushers gnashing in the night.
He bears the burden of his plated weight,
To keep his metal shiny, warm, and bright.

For though he is a thing of wire and steel,
This tiny toaster knows just how to feel.
